description: This file defines a Vue component tree selector engine for both Vue 2 and Vue 3, enabling querying of Vue component instances and their DOM elements based on selectors.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Extracts the base filename without extension, handling Windows drive letters.

methods.name: toUpper
methods.description: Converts a character to uppercase, used as a replacer in string replacement.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Converts a string to PascalCase based on delimiters.

methods.name: buildComponentsTreeVue3
methods.description: Builds a component tree representation for a Vue 3 instance.

methods.name: buildComponentsTreeVue2
methods.description: Builds a component tree representation for a Vue 2 instance.

methods.name: filterComponentsTree
methods.description: Filters a component tree based on a search function.

methods.name: findVueRoots
methods.description: Finds Vue root instances in a DOM scope for both Vue 2 and Vue 3.
